review_text: we wanted to try a new coffee place in davao and Muni Muni didn't disappoint! i ordered a sea salt latte and it was the best i've had in the city, i really recommend!!✨
We were warmly welcomed by the staff. Though I didn't try the food, the hojicha latte was the best I've tried so fair so I would highly recommend. This is now a Davao go-to spot for me.
Good coffee and good food! A must try!
Great coffee, cozy atmosphere, and friendly staff. Definitely a place worth coming back to.
